facts.offering: A bigger child in a red hood bends down and hands a cup holding white flowers to a smaller child.
facts.little-girl: The smaller child wears an orange headscarf and a white glove on one hand.
facts.six-flower-cups: There are six cups holding white star-shaped flowers (four in the front row, one on the stone pedestal, and one being handed over).
facts.pedestal-x: On the stone pedestal at the left, a shield with an X mark is carved.
facts.old-town: Behind, a village courtyard spreads out with an old tower and houses.
facts.walking-guard: At the back left, a person with a spear is walking away.

glosses.offering: A small kindness with no conditions; a heart that was pure.
glosses.walking-guard: A scene where the adult world has stepped back.

reversedGloss.excess: Staying too long in memories and missing the present.
reversedGloss.waning: The ties of the past loosen, and the present returns.
